summary: Found one blocking unattended-execution defect. Existing prebuilt runner passed both ten-game passes; no tests were deleted or weakened, and README scope and integration ownership are accurate.

findings.finding: The launcher has no execution deadline: both stdout.readline() and communicate() can wait indefinitely. A stalled replay leaves the exclusively created receipt empty instead of recording a failed run. Additionally, stderr is not drained until the cold marker arrives, so sufficient panic diagnostics can fill the pipe and deadlock the child. This violates the RFC requirement for bounded unattended verification with useful failure artifacts. Drain both streams concurrently, enforce a configurable deadline covering both passes, terminate/reap the child on expiry, and persist a nonzero failure receipt. Add stalled-child and stderr-flood regression checks.
